test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How does the parliamentary system ensure a “responsible government”?

options.text: By allowing the President to dismiss the Prime Minister at any time
By giving the judiciary the power to review executive decisions
By permitting the military to oversee governance
By making the council of ministers collectively accountable to the Parliament

solution:
The Correct answer is __**By making the council of ministers collectively accountable to the Parliament**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The parliamentary system ensures a **responsible government** by making the **council of ministers collectively accountable to the Parliament**.
 
• This means that if the council of ministers loses the confidence of the Parliament, they are obligated to resign collectively</str
